drawSwath.label: Draw ground swath
drawSwath.helpText: Show the imaging swath of the selected satellite along its drawn orbit.

fieldOfRegardFill.label: Field-of-regard fill
fieldOfRegardFill.helpText: Draw the translucent strip the sensor can reach by tilting, beside the nadir swath.

help.overview: Draws where the selected satellite's sensor can image along the drawn orbit: an opaque nadir swath and a translucent field of regard out to the tilt limit. Stretches where the Sun is below the minimum elevation at the sub-point are dimmed, or hidden with Daylight only. A fan follows the satellite from its position to the swath edges.
help.howToUse: Select a satellite and turn on the Ground Swath layer. Pick a preset or enter a swath width or field of view, the maximum off-nadir tilt and the minimum Sun elevation. Settings are remembered per satellite.
help.tip1: Presets are illustrative, not published specifications for any real sensor.
help.tip2: The field-of-regard fill also follows the Graphics menu quality level (Medium and above).
help.flatMap: The swath is hidden in flat-map mode.
